contract: The i143 acceptance job registry. One job per (issue, layer); each cell's `command` is copied verbatim from the issue's hardened acceptance text and names exactly one test (`-- --exact`). `scripts/i143-acceptance-gate.sh <job-id>` runs every cell of a job from the RDM root, in a shell with `I143_ACCEPTANCE_DIR=<dir>` and `I143_ACCEPTANCE_CELL=<cell>` exported: a cell writes its `result.json` (direct observations) there, a UNIT cell also its `spans.json`; a PROCESS/CONTAINER/FAST cell's estate lands under `<dir>/estate` by the command's own `RDM_ARTIFACTS_DIR`. The runner writes `<dir>/gate.log`, `<dir>/manifest.json` and the job receipt `target/i143-acceptance/jobs/<job-id>.json`. `dir` is always `target/i143-acceptance/<issue>/<layer>/<cell>`. A cell with `evidence: runner` is an existing stem run as a regression: the runner writes its `result.json` itself from the test summary, the estate manifest and the spans files, since an existing stem is never edited to produce one.
